STARLI / YULI BCI 200 / FAMILY 06 QUANTUM NEURAL MAGNETOMETRY / TEN FLAGSHIP RESEARCH DESIGNS F051–F055 | FIVE DISTINCT SCIENTIFIC CONTRACTS F051 Quantum Magnetometry for Neural Activity at the Limit Primary endpoint: phantom magnetic-field amplitude error [fT]. Hidden perturbation: concealed low-frequency external-field insertion. Rival: remote power-line field coupling, rather than a neural-dipole field. F052 Diamond NV-Center Neural Magnetometry at the Limit Primary endpoint: noise-equivalent magnetic sensitivity [T/sqrt(Hz)]. Hidden perturbation: blinded fluorescence count-rate swap. Rival: more photons or optical heating, not spin readout improvement, explains the signal. F053 Optically Pumped Magnetometry for Brain Signals at the Limit Primary endpoint: OPM signal-to-noise ratio [dB]. Hidden perturbation: concealed residual shield gradient. Rival: common-mode shield or laser noise produces the apparent signal benefit. F054 Spatial Resolution of Quantum Magnetometer Arrays at the Limit Primary endpoint: array source-position RMSE [mm]. Hidden perturbation: blind removal of one magnetometer channel. Rival: interpolation smoothing or favorable source depth, rather than improved resolution. F055 Quantum-Assisted Neural Magnetic Field Inversion at the Limit Primary endpoint: magnetic source localization error [mm]. Hidden perturbation: concealed head-phantom conductivity swap. Rival: regularization choice or favored source prior generates an apparent localization gain. FAMILY METHOD / EXPLICIT NONCLINICAL BOUNDARY Each proposed 777-page volume contains 14 three-point research preface pages, 30 mathematical plates, 82 chapters/410 investigations, 200 distinct indexed research tests and 33 Phoenix concepts. Three future letters appear at each Research Gate. The source is an independently metered current dipole; OPM or NV readout does not itself prove neural function, clinical benefit or quantum advantage. STARLI / YULI BCI 200 / FAMILY 06 QUANTUM NEURAL MAGNETOMETRY / TEN FLAGSHIP RESEARCH DESIGNS F056–F060 | FIVE DISTINCT SCIENTIFIC CONTRACTS F056 Low-Field Quantum Neural Magnetometry at the Limit Primary endpoint: low-field calibration bias [pT]. Hidden perturbation: blind background-bias-field step. Rival: incomplete compensation of residual magnetic field masquerades as calibrated sensitivity. F057 Motion-Noise Suppression in Quantum Neural Sensing at the Limit Primary endpoint: residual motion-field mean-square [fT^2]. Hidden perturbation: blinded phantom head-motion injection. Rival: neural-like source signal is removed along with the motion component. F058 Quantum Magnetometry and EEG Fusion at the Limit Primary endpoint: OPM-to-EEG timing difference [ms]. Hidden perturbation: blinded trigger-clock offset. Rival: common stimulation trigger makes two signals seem synchronous without independent neural information. F059 Calibration Traceability in Quantum Neural Magnetometry at the Limit Primary endpoint: magnetic field expanded uncertainty [pT]. Hidden perturbation: blinded coil-constant replacement. Rival: common current-source error yields correlated agreement, not independent calibration. F060 Independent Validation of Quantum Neural Magnetometry at the Limit Primary endpoint: second-site magnetic reproduction error [fT]. Hidden perturbation: blind exchange of OPM model. Rival: shared calibration software or selected successful runs create false between-site agreement. EVIDENCE / DOIs / EXPLICIT OPEN REVIEW ITEMS Budker & Romalis (2007), DOI 10.1038/nphys566; Boto et al. (2018), DOI 10.1038/nature26147; four-channel OPM array (2024), DOI 10.1364/OE.517961; JCGM (2008), DOI 10.59161/JCGM100-2008E. Supplied STARLI F02 methods: 10.5281/zenodo.23486020. All flagship-specific results are untested; gate identities and formula adaptations still need expert review.
